final: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.throws,''),'missing') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS n FROM manager_award m JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, n, n*1.0/(SELECT SUM(n) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS combined_tally, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
